notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
SMB scan of ports 445 and 139 with smb* NSE scripts. Fingerprints OS, SMB version (v1/v2/v3), signing status, and attempts vulnerability checks. Foundation for all SMB enumeration.

=== SMBv1 CRITICAL ===
SMBv1 detection is a critical finding — vulnerable to EternalBlue (MS17-010) and related exploits. smb-vuln-ms17-010 NSE script tests for this directly.

=== SMB SIGNING ===
smb-security-mode NSE shows signing status. signing:disabled means SMB relay attacks are possible — NTLM credentials captured from one system can be relayed to authenticate to another.
